messages.subject: Mathias | Industrial, Metals & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Mathias,

Your work with major German and multinational industrial companies across steel, metals, chemicals, machine building and related sectors, together with Kestria Germany's Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure coverage, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in industrial, metals, energy, mining and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Germany, wider Europe, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria Germany-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
